test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the correct statement from the given options.

options.text: Kudankulam Nuclear Power Station is in Kerala.
Mundra Thermal Power Station is in Madhya Pradesh.
Narora Atomic Power Station is in Uttar Pradesh.
Talcher Super Thermal Power Station is in Andhra Pradesh.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Narora Atomic Power Station is in Uttar Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narora Atomic Power Station** is located in the state of **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• It is one of the important nuclear power plants in India, contributing to the generation of nuclear energy.
 
• The plant is operated by the Nuclear Power Corporation of India Ltd (NPCIL).
 
• It plays a significant role in meeting the energy requirements of the northern region of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kudankulam Nuclear Power Station** is actually located in **Tamil Nadu**, not Kerala.
 
• **Mundra Thermal Power Station** is situated in **Gujarat**, not Madhya Pradesh.
 
• **Talcher Super Thermal Power Station** is located in **Odisha**, not Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The correct identification of the location of these power stations is crucial for general knowledge and competitive exams.
